title: Website Tech Stack Detector input
description: Paste one or more website URLs. Each analyzed site is one billable result; sites that cannot be fetched are reported for free.

urls.title: Website URLs
urls.description: One website per line (or a JSON array of URLs). The scheme is optional: `example.com` and `https://example.com` both work. Duplicates are removed automatically.

detectViaDns.title: Also check DNS records
detectViaDns.description: Look up TXT, MX, NS, SOA and CNAME records to detect email providers, DNS hosts, domain verification for SaaS tools, and more. Adds ~0.5 s per site.

includeDescriptions.title: Include technology descriptions
includeDescriptions.description: Add a short description of every detected technology to the output (makes the dataset larger).

includeEvidence.title: Include detection evidence
includeEvidence.description: List which signals (HTTP header, script URL, meta tag, cookie, DNS record, ...) produced each detection. Useful for auditing results.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to analyze in parallel.

timeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a website after this many seconds.

maxRetries.title: Retries per website
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a website that fails to load before reporting it as failed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Route requests through Apify Proxy if some target sites block cloud IP addresses. Proxy usage is billed by Apify separately from this Actor's per-site price.
